task.title: A health check route for the Projects API
behaviours: GET /v1/health returns 200 application/json with the body { "status": "ok" }.
GET /v1/health ignores query parameters and still returns 200 with { "status": "ok" }.
An unknown method on /v1/health (e.g. POST) does not return 200.
All existing tests keep passing and the public contract only gains routes and properties.
task.change:
Add GET /v1/health so a load balancer or a deploy check can tell the API is up.
It answers 200 application/json { "status": "ok" } and needs no request body or
parameters. It lives in its own module and is registered on the app next to the
projects routes. No existing route, request schema or response schema changes.
